L8n908.name: Sea and shipping
L8n908.description: Fires on sea, port and ship words; pushes toward sea, ocean and shore words.

L19n834.name: Ships and marine water
L19n834.description: Negative pole fires on ship, dock and port words; writes marine and sailor words, but steering gives generic fiction.

L27n267.name: Mid-word piece to LaTeX
L27n267.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split word or name; pushes toward $-delimited math variables such as $a and $b.

L27n892.name: Name syllable to LaTeX

L14n92.name: Scattered words to closers
L14n92.description: Fires on assorted content words and commas with no shared theme; pushes toward closing quote and bracket punctuation.

L27n832.name: Word piece to brackets
L27n832.description: Fires on word fragments, Georgian script and names; pushes toward closing brackets and quotes such as ) and ].

L14n2251.name: Weak diffuse noise
L14n2251.description: Barely fires on academic and technical nouns; writes scattered word fragments with no shared concept.

L27n1332.name: Capital initial to plus
L27n1332.description: Negative pole fires on capitals and acronyms (N, U.S., NY); pushes toward plus-prefixed tokens such as +a and +N.

L27n390.name: Word piece to equals
L27n390.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and Georgian fragments; pushes toward equals-sign tokens such as =A and =B.

L27n711.name: Name syllable to plus
L27n711.description: Negative pole fires on name and word openers (Re-, We-, Se-); pushes toward plus-prefixed tokens such as +A and +B.

L27n1266.name: Word start to colon
L27n1266.description: Fires on word openers (Be-, Bre-, Car-); pushes toward colon-closer tokens such as ': and ):.

L27n1672.name: Name start to quotes
L27n1672.description: Negative pole fires on name openers and prepositions (of, for); pushes toward closing-quote and paren tokens.

L27n587.name: Name start to parens
L27n587.description: Negative pole fires on name openers (Domenici, Iberian, Bre-); pushes toward closing paren and semicolon tokens.

L27n1654.name: Stem piece to ur
L27n1654.description: Fires on stems that split a longer technical word (conj-, metall-, cyan-); pushes toward 'ur' and 'URL' tokens.

L27n2479.name: Compound piece to sn
L27n2479.description: Negative pole fires on compound-word pieces (supers-, outs-, odd-); pushes toward 'sn' tokens.

L27n276.name: Sentence opener to nouns
L27n276.description: Negative pole fires on sentence openers (Under, By, In, After); pushes toward nouns such as book, board and box.

L26n1211.name: Miles unit to ap
L26n1211.description: Negative pole fires on 'miles' after a number and on word stems; pushes toward 'ap' tokens.

L27n863.name: Mid-word fragment completer
L27n863.description: Reads scattered mid-word fragments and nouns (Beorht w-, Car-, uta, ari) with no shared theme; pushes toward 'min' tokens.

L27n2682.name: Government security terms
L27n2682.description: Fires on words that lead into official or national-security phrases (Homeland, national, Jurisdiction); pushes toward 'sec' and 'security'.

L27n1531.name: Weak scattered, writes reflect
L27n1531.description: Weak, scattered reads (Chariho, Superwoman, 'waves' in water imagery); pushes toward 'reflect' words.

L27n2247.name: Physics terms, writes return
L27n2247.description: Reads quantity 'of' and physics terms (light emission, scintillator, radioactive, Ehrfurt); pushes toward 'return'.

L26n1244.name: Word-start intr- and inter- prefixes
L26n1244.description: Fires on word-start fragments like 'intr-' and 'inter-' (intranet, intersex); pushes toward 'prefix' and 'notation'.

L27n622.name: Proper-name starts, mojibake writer
L27n622.description: Fires on first letters of proper names (Linares, Bruchac, Reher); pushes toward mojibake bytes like 'Â' and 'â'.

L27n1161.name: Name stem before fixed phrase
L27n1161.description: Fires on the stem before a fixed name or phrase (Cooperative, Par-, Rio de, Granada); pushes toward 'extension'.

L25n162.name: Weak fragments, writes wait
L25n162.description: Weak reads on word fragments (herm-aph-, trans-Antarctic, Ge-orgian); pushes toward 'wait' tokens.

L25n1364.name: Diverse fragments, writes node
L25n1364.description: Fires on assorted word-start fragments (Linares, Ins-, van-, Dr.) with no single theme; pushes toward 'node'.

L27n1367.name: Flat weak noise, writes input
L27n1367.description: Near-flat weak firing on random single words (manpower, vocabulary, work); pushes toward 'input'.

L26n876.name: Name starts, writes brackets
L26n876.description: Fires on starts of names and places (St-, Se-, Oltenberg, Domenici); pushes toward closing brackets like '])),' and ')))'.

L27n961.name: Diffuse reads, writes Pro
L27n961.description: Diffuse weak reads (Nile, Roman, Ellsworth, '10' in percentages); pushes toward 'Pro' tokens.

L25n24.name: Prepositions before names, writes brackets
L25n24.description: Fires on prepositions and 'Yes' before an institution or name (at Georgia Tech, in Pasadena); pushes toward code brackets like '()):'.

L27n632.name: Parentheses and dashes, writes suffixes
L27n632.description: Fires on opening parentheses, dashes and periods mid-sentence; pushes toward verb suffixes like '-ting' and '-ted'.

L26n1968.name: Mid-word fragments, writes union
L26n1968.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (inc-, chron-, Franc-, morph-); pushes toward 'union' tokens.

L27n620.name: Determiner before modifier, writes adjectives
L27n620.description: Fires on 'a', 'his', 'my' before a modifier (a new world record, a substantive bill); pushes toward intensity adjectives like 'robust' and 'rigorous'.

L26n2867.name: Name fragments, writes van
L26n2867.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of surnames and places (Bebense, Boddington, Shanidar); pushes toward 'van' and Dutch-name tokens.

L25n2845.name: Name fragments, certainty writes
L25n2845.description: Reads mid-word fragments of rare names and words (Be-, Tan-, Q-); pushes toward absolutes: always, guaranteed, definitely.

L27n2781.name: Word-fragment reads, prime writes
L27n2781.description: Reads scattered mid-word fragments of multi-token words (Franc-, Pr-, Bl-); pushes toward 'prime'.

L25n2781.name: Safety warnings
L25n2781.description: Reads safety and emergency-procedure text (active shooter, Emergency Management, escape); pushes toward 'safe' and 'safety'.

L23n2405.name: Than comparison predictor
L23n2405.description: Reads comparatives right before 'than' (more, rather, less, most); pushes toward 'than'.

L25n1019.name: Options after setup words
L25n1019.description: Reads verbs and prepositions that set up an object (prevent, Request, into, of); pushes toward 'options'.

L25n409.name: Mojibake reads, code closers
L25n409.description: Reads mojibake and accented-letter fragments in garbled text; pushes toward closing quotes and parentheses.

L23n2299.name: Weak reads, vector writes
L23n2299.description: Weak, scattered reads on technical nouns and word fragments (acceleration, Jet, Feature); pushes toward 'vector'.

L22n2377.name: Consequence phrases, effect writes
L22n2377.description: Reads loosely on consequence and outcome phrases (cumulative effects, withdrawal, fluorescence energy); pushes toward 'effect' and 'effects'.

L26n2666.name: Name fragments, DNA writes
L26n2666.description: Reads word-start fragments of names and technical terms (beta-arr-, nanop-, Beg-); pushes toward 'DNA' and 'password'.

L24n2899.name: Connectives read, port writes
L24n2899.description: Reads connective function words mid-phrase (and, for, in, has); pushes toward 'port'.

L27n1642.name: Section-heading reads, clause writes
L27n1642.description: Reads capitalized section and heading starts (TEACHING, PLANNING, RESOURCES); pushes toward clause openers From, If, For, And.

L26n240.name: Opening brackets, scattered nouns
L26n240.description: Reads opening brackets and quotes before a gloss or list item; pushes toward scattered nouns (board, top, width).

L22n2178.name: Weak question reads, proof writes
L22n2178.description: Weak reads on problem-set punctuation and pronouns ('problem 3:', 'Is it a curve?'); pushes toward 'proof' and 'prove'.

L21n1228.name: Weak function-word reads, zero
L21n1228.description: Very weak reads on function words after verbs (because, with, of, to); pushes toward 'zero'.

L24n948.name: Intersex reads, opposite writes
L24n948.description: Reads 'inter-' in intersex and 'at/in the same' phrases; pushes toward 'opposite' and 'adjacent'.

L21n1442.name: Superlatives read, choice writes
L21n1442.description: Reads superlatives and best-pick words (top, best, leading, ideal, first); pushes toward 'choice' and 'choices'.
